_comment: Library corruption dialogue (old LibraryCorruptionDialogue). steps run in order: {lines:[{s,t,give?}]} or {ask:[buttons], replies:[[lines] per button]}. s = speaker (empty = narrator), give = detector_map. Every t and ask text is 'archivist.key|english' (key in archivist_lang/<code>.json, English = fallback and timing). Speaker names stay TOAST/DOG.

replies.t: archivist.corr.1.r0.0|This is what's left of your world now.
archivist.corr.1.r0.1|All dimensions have been corrupted.
archivist.corr.1.r0.2|Safetyprotocol's making, or tenature.
archivist.corr.1.r0.3|However you wanna call him.
archivist.corr.1.r0.4|Guess he couldn't stand you trying to take his place.
archivist.corr.1.r1.0|When you attempted to erase the Tenature…,
archivist.corr.1.r1.1|or safetyprotocol, his actual name,
archivist.corr.1.r1.2|the Tenature took notice and corrupted all dimensions.
archivist.corr.1.r2.0|Because you failed to do your duty.
archivist.corr.1.r2.1|What else did you expect?
archivist.corr.1.r2.2|The Tenature… or safetyprotocol,
archivist.corr.1.r2.3|however you wanna call him, wasn't deleted
archivist.corr.1.r2.4|and now he's trying to erase the Archivist's dimensions too.
archivist.corr.1.r2.5|Your world, or at least wherever you were taking residence
archivist.corr.1.r2.6|is now corrupted and probably gone in no time.

lines.t: archivist.corr.2.0|Listen. I didn't want to do this. Getting involved in your mess should be the last of my problems.
archivist.corr.2.1|Since I am the only one who can read in this place, I know a thing or two about backup plans.

ask: archivist.corr.3.ask2|> You know I can read too, right?

replies.t: archivist.corr.3.r0.0|Yes. I have a plan.
archivist.corr.3.r0.1|A plan to stop this fake entity that keeps trying to pretend to be you.
archivist.corr.3.r0.2|Its facade has been falling apart for years,
archivist.corr.3.r0.3|so we're essentially here to expose it.
archivist.corr.3.r1.0|Listen.
archivist.corr.3.r1.1|We can actually erase the Tenature.
archivist.corr.3.r1.2|That's what I am trying to say here.
archivist.corr.3.r2.0|Oh, shut up. I really don't care.
archivist.corr.3.r2.1|I already don't want to do this with you.
archivist.corr.3.r2.2|You're gonna be a hassle, huh?

lines.t: archivist.corr.4.0|We need you to backtrack a little and get to the source.
archivist.corr.4.1|Remember the_end? Probably heard of it.
archivist.corr.4.3|We need her to get Tenature deleted once and for all.
archivist.corr.4.4|She's the only one that has access above him.

ask: archivist.corr.5.ask1|> Are you sure about this?

replies.t: archivist.corr.5.r0.0|Supposedly this will help you find the end portal.
archivist.corr.5.r0.1|I have no idea.
archivist.corr.5.r0.2|Don't lose it, or else it'll be more difficult getting around.
archivist.corr.5.r1.0|Yes.
archivist.corr.5.r1.1|Unfortunately, She's waiting for no one but you.

lines.t: archivist.corr.6.0|Alright, well what are you waiting for? The world needs you.
archivist.corr.6.1|Find the Archivist. Or else everything will be deleted.
archivist.corr.6.2|Objective: beat the Ender Dragon. Find the end portal with the detector map.
